messages.subject: RHipe 0.73.1 : rhinit() problem
parts:
Hi,
I installed RHipe 0.73.1  over CDH3.
When I run rhinit(), I get following error:

> rhinit()
Rhipe: Using Rhipe.jar file
Initializing Rhipe v0.73
Initializing mapfile caches
Error in .jcall("RJavaTools", "Ljava/lang/Object;", "invokeMethod", cl,  :
  java.lang.IncompatibleClassChangeError: class com.google.common.cache.CacheBuilder$3 has interface com.google.common.base.Ticker as super class

Please help, what could be  the problem?
